# Catppuccin Mocha

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-mocha)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-mocha)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-mocha)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-mocha)

Catppuccin Mocha is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the Catppuccin family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-mocha codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `catppuccinMocha` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { catppuccinMocha } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-mocha';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, catppuccinMocha],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `catppuccinMocha` | `Extension` |
| `catppuccinMochaMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#1e1e2e` |
| Active line | `#28283b` |
| Selection | `#353648` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.53:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#cba6f7` | bold | 8.07:1 | 7.10:1 | 5.83:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#cba6f7` | bold | 8.07:1 | 7.10:1 | 5.83:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#89dceb` | - | 10.54:1 | 9.27:1 | 7.62:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#9b9fb6` | - | 6.27:1 | 5.51:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#cdd6f4` | - | 11.34:1 | 9.97:1 | 8.19:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#fab387` | - | 9.27:1 | 8.14:1 | 6.69:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#89b4fa` | - | 7.79:1 | 6.85:1 | 5.63:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#89b4fa` | - | 7.79:1 | 6.85:1 | 5.63:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#f9e2af` | - | 12.91:1 | 11.34:1 | 9.32:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#f9e2af` | italic | 12.91:1 | 11.34:1 | 9.32:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#fab387` | italic | 9.27:1 | 8.14:1 | 6.69:1 |
| String | `string` | `#a6e3a1` | - | 11.03:1 | 9.69:1 | 7.97:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#f5c2e7` | - | 10.74:1 | 9.44:1 | 7.76:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#fab387` | - | 9.27:1 | 8.14:1 | 6.69:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#fab387` | - | 9.27:1 | 8.14:1 | 6.69:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#cdd6f4` | - | 11.34:1 | 9.97:1 | 8.19:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#9c9fb5` | italic | 6.28:1 | 5.52:1 | 4.54:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#cdd6f4` | background, active line, selection | 8.19:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#9c9fb5` | gutter | 6.72:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#f5e0dc` | background, active line | 11.38:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#b4befe` | background | 9.17:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #b4befe` | background, active line | 8.06:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#89b4fa, 1px solid #74c7ec` | background (fill or outline) | 8.69:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#585b7066` | active line | 1.22:1 | Pass |
